topic: Fundamentals of Vector Spaces: Span, Dependence, and Bases

sections.title: Prerequisite Review: The Vector Concept
lecture_lines: Vectors are directed segments from the origin.
Scaling and adding vectors creates linear combinations.
animations: Create a labeled vector arrow from origin on a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg], colored #FF5733.
Animate the vector scaling by a factor of 2.
Rotate the vector by 45 degrees counter-clockwise using a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/protractor.svg].
Show vector addition using the parallelogram rule.
Highlight the resultant vector with a bright #33FF57 color.

sections.title: The Concept of Span: 'Reachability'
lecture_lines: Span is the set of all reachable points.
Think of it as area covered by vectors.
Vectors define what space we can reach.
animations: Visualize origin point and two vectors in 2D space using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].
Animate scalar multiplication of vectors filling 2D plane.
Highlight the span area with a semi-transparent #3385FF.

sections.title: Linear Dependence: The 'Redundant' Vector
lecture_lines: Linear dependence means one vector is redundant.
It adds no new dimensions to space.
Dependent vectors lie on existing planes.
animations: Display two vectors, one as a multiple of another using a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg] to measure the scaling.
Highlight the second vector fading away, #808080.
Show the remaining basis vector staying static, #FFFFFF, drawn by a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/pencil.svg].

sections.title: Bases: The Minimalist Framework
lecture_lines: A basis is a minimal spanning set.
It provides an efficient coordinate system.
No redundancy, yet spans the space perfectly.
animations: Display a grid of lines formed by two vectors using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg].
Highlight the intersection points as unique coordinates.
Label the basis vectors 'i-hat' and 'j-hat' in #FFFF00.

sections.title: Summary & Synthesis
lecture_lines: Linear combinations build up our spanning sets.
Redundancy creates linear dependence in vectors.
Bases are the minimal set for space.
animations: Briefly summarize span concept with a recap animation.
Display linear dependence rule as a formula #FF00FF.
Show a basis forming a complete coordinate system.
